verification_methodology.disclosure: Spring-return damped single-acting piston pump (18 mm bore, 1.8 mm nozzle, 45 mm physical stop, assumed 300 N/m return spring, 340 N*s/m damping, 0.6 N seal friction) driven by a time-limited 3D thumb force projected onto the live MuJoCo slide axis on surveyed Nova-Wanderland Site A (1hMoHmA-KJVleTI6UFeNI__dS4JvJNls9, Neighborhood park); base traversal and Panda wrist aiming are kinematically tracked. Differential displaced volume and continuity outlet speed feed an air-dragged ballistic parcel + 0.22 mm thin-film solver ray-cast against time-matched fixed catchment surfaces (separating in-flight liquid from planter and footpath impacts), with actual-pump axial, off-axis (same norm), and nozzle-aim perturbation controls.
